verdict: Organic activity is slowing; paid channels are offline and being addressed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came from organic sources — no paid spend ran on Meta or Google. Your Google Business Profile delivered 154 actions (68 calls, 51 direction requests, 35 website clicks), but that momentum has stalled: actions dropped 41% in the most recent 7 days and went to zero for three consecutive days October 16–18. Instagram reach has also been effectively dark for the past eight days with no paid support to backstop it. Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to restore a reliable lead flow before the engagement closes October 31.
